title: My first Live-in Relationship | Stand-up comedy by Swati Sachdeva
description:
India & Australia Tour Ticket Link:
https://linktr.ee/Swatisachdeva

Presenting ‘My first Live-in Relationship’ - Pure joy, pure jokes.
In this stand-up comedy set, I talk about living with your partner, hiding your relationship from your maid, dealing with everyday chaos, and answering one of the questions people seem most curious about when it comes to same-sex couples:

“Who’s the Man of the Relationship?”
 Featuring one relationship and everyone’s opinions about it. Happy Pride Month! 🌈
